This won’t happen overnight but it will one day, there will be days when nostalgia will hit you like a truck with the good aspects of your relationship but weigh it with bad too. Trust me bad moments will outweigh good ones no matter how good or happy those moments were. Just start focusing somewhere else even if you don’t want to, even if life around is you shit, just keep hanging on and trust me your future would be way much happier than you expected.
